metric_definition.rule: P~ = P^ if finite and > 0, else 1/B; valid estimates never modified; no upper clamp
metric_definition.ile: mean over all grid points with truth > 0 of |log P~ - log truth|
metric_definition.coverage: fraction of grid points with a finite positive estimate
metric_definition.floor: 1/B, where B is the charged simulator-evaluation count of the arm and seed

arm_b.rationale: every oracle candidate is charged (3 N per threshold)

arm_c.rationale: all six oracle configurations are charged; the cost varies by seed with the number of AMS levels
